Dizzy in Greece is an album by trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie, recorded in 1956 and 1957 and released on the Verve label.[2]

Release history

[edit]

The album was reissued as part of the 2CD compilation Birks Works: The Verve Big Band Sessions.[3][4]

Reception

[edit]

The AllMusic review awarded the album 4.5 stars.[5]
